name: Omar
overview: Omar is identified in Scripture as a son of Eliphaz and a grandson of Esau, highlighting his place within the genealogical line of Edom. The passages in Genesis 36 and 1 Chronicles 1 list Omar among the sons of Eliphaz, who are described as dukes or leaders among the descendants of Esau. This genealogical record emphasizes the continuation of Esau's lineage through Eliphaz, with Omar recognized as one of the prominent tribal chiefs.
